notes.title: Deception, Dreams, & Dark Secrets in 7 Years From Now
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that [b]award winning narrative adventure[/b], 7 Years From Now, will be launching on Steam on 28th May!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40192613/41a18b17eba40d4dd1697d87817aad4d3e72e7ec.png[/img]
A mature, emotional and uniquely wrenching single player experience
[list]
[*] [b]All DLC included[/b], featuring epilogue, side story, glossary and Sound Mode
[*] Rated [b]4.9 / 5 on iOS, 4.6 / 5 on Google Play[/b]
[*] Winner of 5 awards including Vivo's Best Indie Game, Huawei Most Exciting
[*] [b]Downloaded over 6,000,000[/b] times on mobile
[*] Launching on Steam & Nintendo Switch on 28th May, 2021
[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40192613/93b073b5dcfa1297f37484b062c6d511ca688247.png[/img]

First launched in 2017 for mobile, the deceptively dark and wonderful '7 Years From Now' charmed audiences with its [b]deeply engrossing story, minimalist voxel art style and ambient score soundtrack.[/b] 
 
[b]Check out the 7 Years From Now Trailer:[/b]
[previewyoutube=pfYKGVISkv4;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40192613/49363a122d88e000f7a50241be6ff0170c677b38.png[/img]

Developed as a labour of love by Mafumi Yoshida, a one-man development team, 7 Years From Now is a uniquely emotive non-combat based narrative experience.
 
Embark on a surreal journey retracing the steps of old memories lost 7 years prior. Take on the role of high school student Haruto Soraki as he returns to his hometown on a quest to recover his memory after being involved in an accident, which he knows nothing about.
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40192613/f5d7a6104a8cd276ed66edfcc78bfcda131a7bb3.png[/img]

In this wonderfully charming yet sinister slice of life adventure, reacquaint yourself with forgotten friends, discover hidden depths as you expose a horrifying conspiracy and learn the truth of your past once and for all.

For more information and the latest news, follow us on:
https://pqube.co.uk/7-years-from-now/

Sarah and the PQube-Team
